input.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity to Article XII and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs only one way: Licensee indemnifies Licensor for essentially all use of the licensed technology, and Article XIII expressly excludes Licensor liability for infringement claims. We have added a Licensor indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breaches it causes and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct (with standard notice/control/cooperation and remedies), and narrowed our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our own breach of law, consistent with our playbook position. If helpful, we can accept the customary infringement exclusions (Licensee modifications, combinations and specifications) and a super-cap at 3x annual fees.

ops.text: (b) Notwithstanding Article XIII or any other provision of this Agreement, Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting suits, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, API's, Documentation or any other materials or services provided by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. If the Licensed Technology is or is alleged to infringe, Licensor shall, at its expense and Licensee's option, procure the right for Licensee to continue using it, modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing while remaining functionally equivalent, or refund all fees paid for the affected Licensed Technology.

(c) The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought, shall permit the indemnifying party to control the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on, or requiring any admission by, the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), and shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. Failure to give prompt notice shall relieve the indemnifying party of its obligations only to the extent it is materially prejudiced thereby.
